[SWS_DM_01263] Storage of
RoE
events
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04160
⌈
If
DiagnosticResponseOnEventClass.storeEventEnabled
is set to TRUE,
the DM shall support the functionality of the
RoE
service with the storeState bit (Bit6)
set to true according to ISO 14229-1[1].
⌋
